d.ko: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

d.zh: 【 村庄建设动作RPG 】被女神拯救的你，降临在一个被魔王统治的荒芜世界。收集素材建造设施，灵活切换能改变职业的帽子，为村民分配工作，一起让村庄繁荣兴旺。然而……在某天夜晚，隔壁城堡里举办了偶像魔王的演唱会，狂热的魔物大军如潮水般涌入村庄！？
